description: Splitter with one input copied to eight outputs, each output gated open or shut by its own CV input

inputs.text: The voltage copied to every output whose CV input is high
Holds its output open while the voltage here is 1.7V or above, and shuts it to 0V below that

outputs.text: Carries the IN voltage while its CV input is 1.7V or above, and 0V below that

notes: an output stays at 0V until its own CV input is taken to 1.7V or above, so with the CV jacks empty nothing comes out at all
the lamp beside an output is lit while that output is open
